newsitem.title: USA: Rock-Tenn Co to buy Waldorf Corp.
newsitem.headline: Rock-Tenn Co to buy Waldorf Corp.

text.p: Rock-Tenn Co said Friday it had agreed in principle to acquire the outstanding capital stock of the privately owned parent of Waldorf Corp for about $410 million.

Waldorf, a St. Paul, Minn.-based manufacturer of folding cartons and recycled paperboard and corrugating medium, had net income of $17.4 million on net sales of $377 million in its fiscal year ended June 30, 1996.
The $410 million price includes cash to be paid at closing as well as net long-term debt of Waldorf to be outstanding at closing.
Rock-Tenn said it intends to finance the acquisition, including any refinancing of Waldorf's debt, with cash and borrowings under a new $400 million credit facility.
It said it plans to repay a portion of such borrowings with net proceeds of a public offering of equity securities early in 1997.
The acquisition is expected to close in January, it said.
